GetChatList.label: List all saved chats
GetChatList.description: Returns list of chats with id, title, date_short, message_count

params.project_id: Optional filter by project (use 'default' for unassigned)

LoadChat.label: Load a chat by ID
LoadChat.description: Returns full chat content including all messages

params.chat_id: Required - the chat ID to load

CreateChat.label: Create a new chat
CreateChat.description: Creates a new chat file and returns the chat_id

AppendMessage.label: Append a message to a chat
AppendMessage.description: Appends a user or assistant message to a chat. Creates chat if chat_id is null.

params.chat_id: Chat ID (null to create new chat)
params.title: Optional title for new chat
params.page_url: Optional page URL for new chat metadata
params.page_title: Optional page title for new chat metadata

RenameChat.label: Rename a chat
RenameChat.description: Updates the title of an existing chat

params.chat_id: Required - the chat ID to rename
params.title: Required - the new title

params.chat_id: Required - the chat ID to delete

AppendUserMessage.label: Append a user message to the current chat
AppendUserMessage.description: Appends a user message. Uses CURRENT_CHAT_ID or creates new chat.

params.page_url: Optional page URL for new chat metadata
params.page_title: Optional page title for new chat metadata

AppendAssistantMessage.label: Append an assistant message to the current chat
AppendAssistantMessage.description: Appends an assistant message. Uses CURRENT_CHAT_ID or creates new chat.

GetCurrentChat.label: Get the current active chat
GetCurrentChat.description: Returns the current chat ID and chat data

SetCurrentChat.label: Set the current active chat
SetCurrentChat.description: Sets which chat is the current active chat

params.chat_id: Required - the chat ID to make current
